sources: Alexander Novak (Russian Deputy Prime Minister, on-record Oct 23); Dawn newspaper (T3)

sections.what_happened: Novak said Friday the first THREE tankers carrying Russian diesel are on their way to North America -- the first such flow since the 2022 sanctions (Agioi Fanendes, 40,000t, ETA New York Nov 7 per prior scans). Dawn corroborates: 'a sanctions-waiver deal by President Donald Trump sends a tanker filled with Russian diesel steaming toward New York.' Context (earlier scans): Oct 9 diesel deal 300,000t immediately + 500,000t Nov + 1Mt after; Treasury licence through Apr 7, 2027; Fox News: Trump waiving most new Russia sanctions (single-source, uncorroborated layer); AEI's Hal Brands: 'biggest effort yet to start unwinding the US sanctions architecture.'
sections.what_verified: The 'three tankers' count is Novak's on-record claim, single primary-source family; the North America diesel flow itself is corroborated by Dawn (T3) and the Agioi Fanendes leg by Reuters exclusive + Peskov (earlier scans). The waiver-scope layer remains Fox News single-source (no declared tier).
sections.what_disputed: Novak is a Russian official with an interest in advertising the deal; the 'three tankers' count has no independent confirmation (no AIS/owner data in window). US diesel price ~$6.30/gal (prior scan claim) is the domestic pressure behind the waiver -- attributed, not independently verified.
sections.why_matters: Three Russian tankers are sailing toward America -- the first since 2022. While Washington talks sanctions, the diesel is already on the water. Follow the tankers, not the threats. (Sanctions Ledger)
sections.context: Background: UPDATE (Sanctions Ledger / Diesel franchise) -- Russian DPM Novak: FIRST THREE tankers with Russian diesel are on their way to North America; Dawn corroborates a tanker 'steaming toward New York'
